niche: a Scottish third-party fulfilment centre forecasting the mis-pick claims a cosmetics brand's customers will lodge on 2027's online orders once a product-family re-slot of its shelving pick faces goes live in January, every parcel being check-weighed at packing against a fixed tolerance, under the brand's order-accuracy KPI
answer: Hold the family re-slot as drawn: about 3,800 mis-pick claims on 2027's order lines, 3.7 per 10,000 against the Schedule 3 limit of 2.5, where today's layout stays at 1.7
stakeholder_role: Lathmor's head of quality at its Uphall fulfilment centre, who signs the Aubrine account's 2027 claims budget and, with the brand, the shelving re-slot's January go-live

layer1: the brand's claims register keyed by its own product codes and order numbers, the WMS keyed by item and location codes, crossed through the item master
claims lodged in the window on lines despatched before it, duplicates, customer-error rejections, open claims and other claim reasons

driver: A count of errors that slip past a downstream check is a fixed share of the work only while what each error can turn into stays the same: the check stops an error only when the substitute differs from the intended item by more than a tolerance on a measured total, and the substitutes within reach are fixed by what sits beside each intended item, so a rearrangement that puts near-equal items side by side raises the slipping count while the error rate itself is unchanged, and the forward count is the slip rate per near-equal neighbouring opportunity carried onto the rearranged neighbours, well above the count per unit of work and far from what a similarity-of-kind multiplier gives.
driver_concrete: Every Aubrine parcel is check-weighed at Lathmor's pack benches against 15 g, so a mis-pick reaches a customer only when the item taken from the next face weighs within 15 g of the one ordered; the January re-slot of the shelving zones puts each line's shades side by side, lifting the share of picks beside such a face from 15.6 to 34.5 per cent while the caught mis-picks show pickers err no more often beside look-alikes; carried per exposed pick, the 52 weeks' 1,619 claims put 2027 at 3,800 (3.7 per 10,000 lines, over the 2.5 limit), against 1,700 at the claims per line and 1,400 or 1,800 under a look-alike multiplier fitted on the same claims.
stump: Carrying the 52 weeks' claims per 10,000 lines onto the plan's 2027 lines files 1,700 claims, 1.7 per 10,000 and inside the limit; the step that lands it there is treating claims as a fixed share of picking, when they are only the mis-picks the check-weigh lets through, which happen where an item's neighbour weighs within 15 g of it, and only the claims per pick beside such a face, carried onto the plan's faces and lines, gives 3,800, 3.7 per 10,000, over the limit.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the claims register to validated wrong-item claims on the 52 weeks' despatches, reads Schedule 3 and the plan correctly and carries 1.67 claims per 10,000 lines onto the plan's 2027 lines files 1,700 (1.7 per 10,000, inside the 2.5 limit); a look-alike multiplier fitted on claims beside same-line or same-family faces files 1,400 or 1,800; only the rate per pick beside a face within 15 g, read off the claims' ordered and received products and the caught holds and carried onto the plan's faces, gives 3,800 and 3.7 (executed in checks.py on the shipped rows).
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the unrecovered error probability of a picking task, worked the way human reliability assessment works it: the error's own probability per opportunity, held where the caught exceptions show it does not move, times the probability that the downstream check fails to recover it, which depends on the form the error takes against the check; with a ward's or a call centre's nouns there is no check that recovers an error by the physical size of the substitute against a tolerance and no layout that fixes which substitute is within reach, so the call has nothing to stand on.

differentiation.task156: task156's first architecture carries a closed pool's leaving rate by tenure, the fast leavers going first so the open pool's rate overstates forward losses; here nothing leaves a pool and the error rate per pick holds, and the forward count turns on which errors a downstream check lets through, set by the weight of the item beside each pick face, which the re-slot rearranges
differentiation.task452: task452 weights reference observations by their own design inclusion probabilities after a classification revision; here nothing is sampled or weighted, the claims are every error the check let through, and the forward count is their rate per weight-alike neighbouring pick carried onto a new arrangement of the faces

lineage.niche: a Columbus payroll services company sizing the first-time-employer line of its 2027 sales plan across twelve Great Lakes, Ohio Valley and Mid-Atlantic states from the Census business formation statistics, when Ohio, Pennsylvania and Michigan, its three largest markets, put the IRS employer identification number application inside the state's online business formation filing in 2023 and retired their older filing routes between October 2025 and February 2026, so business applications there roughly doubled while every state, the nine others included, rose about an eighth on a common wave from autumn 2025
lineage.driver: A cut in the cost of entering a leading count draws in marginal entrants who seldom go on to the outcome, so each entrant the cut adds yields a fraction of what an ordinary entrant yields, while a common rise in the count across every region over the same months is ordinary and yields in full; only the treated regions read against the untreated ones, before and after, separate the two and give the added entrants' yield, and carried per added entrant onto a forward period holding far more of them than any closed cohort, it puts the treated regions' outcome below their own latest yield, above zero, and far below the average or high-propensity yield.
lineage.driver_concrete: Ohio's, Pennsylvania's and Michigan's online formation filings now file the IRS application for an employer identification number for every new business that ticks the box, so applications there rose about a quarter while the older routes stayed open and by about two thirds once each state retired them (January to March 2026), while every state, the nine others included, rose about a tenth into the twelve months on a common rise from early 2026; read against those nine before and after, the applications the reform added formed employers within four quarters at about a quarter of the ordinary rate in the closed 2023 to 2025 cohorts, and carried per added application onto the plan's twelve months of applications to September 2026, with the common rise at the ordinary rate, it puts Kilbourne's 2027 first-time employers at 2,500, well under each state's latest closed rate (2,800), the high-propensity split or the pre-reform rate, over the reform states' own before-and-after split (2,400) and well over a zero yield for the added applications (2,300).
lineage.stump: Carrying each state's formations within four quarters per application over its latest four closed quarters onto the twelve months of applications to September 2026 at the plan's 2025 share files 2,800; the step that lands it there is treating the reform states' latest closed rate as theirs, when it is a mix of ordinary and added applications whose added share rises from about a fifth of the closed cohorts to about a third of the twelve months, and only the added applications' own yield, read against the nine other states before and after and carried per added application, gives 2,500.
lineage.answer: 2,500 new first-time employers in the 2027 plan's first-time-employer line (twelve core states, nearest 100)

notes: Domain: human-factors-ergonomics/human-reliability-assessment (F): the deciding quantity is an unrecovered human error rate, a picking error's own probability times its check's failure to recover it, the form HRA gives a task with a downstream check; supply-chain-logistics, the house domain a warehouse would sit in, maps to urban-regional-science and general-statistics-data-science, neither of which carries a human error estimate. Strategy: forecast_method_backtest (F6), a rate stationary only in a constructed exposure (picks with a weight-alike neighbour), the per-line rate back-testing clean on the stable layout and failing forward; validated_decoy false: no certified or closed record blesses the per-line route; the KPI history is the brand's own monthly count, and the claims register's ordered and received items refute the per-line route on the twelve months already held. Ask records chosen first: the staffing agency's weekly invoices (premiums settled per four-week pay period, unlabelled, on the first invoice after the period closes) and the returns bench's grading log (codes 2 and 3 swapped meaning at the handheld go-live, read only through the repack partner's monthly bills).
